feature_article.title: The New Provenance: How Solana Token Extensions Are Changing Digital Ownership
feature_article.author: Clara Meyer
feature_article.body: Every digital artwork now carries its full creation record, from the moment a brush hits a tablet to the final sale on a collector's shelf. Token Extensions on Solana make this possible without smart contract overhead.
feature_article.pull_quote: The blockchain no longer just records who owns what. It records how it was made, who influenced it, and what it means.
